lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular blobs posterior to the gills, arranged in approximately five vertical columns with 3-5 distinct spots per column in the mid-lateral section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the columns of circular blobs, creating a grid-like lattice of anchor nodes across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible in the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp intensity gradient with high luminance on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Two distinct, dark vertical linear indentations are visible immediately posterior to the final gill slit, suggesting healed physical trauma or unique structural marking.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin in the lower left quadrant displays a significantly higher spatial density of smaller, irregularly arranged high-luminance spots compared to the primary lateral flank.
